name: Dan Stec

sponsored.t: Relates to the residency requirement for the St. Lawrence county public health director and community services director
sponsored.sum: Exempts persons holding the offices of public health director and director of community services of St. Lawrence county from the requirement that such person be a resident of the political subdivision or municipal corporation of the state for which such person shall be chosen or within which such person's official functions are required to be exercised.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of revenues from hotel or motel taxes in the county of Essex
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of revenues from hotel or motel taxes in the county of Essex for the use of tourism promotion and development and economic development.

sponsored.t: Increases the occupancy tax in the county of St. Lawrence
sponsored.sum: Increases the occupancy tax in the county of St. Lawrence from three to five percent.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Officer Stephen L. Raymond
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system, consisting of the bridge located on Diamond Point road at exit twenty-three of interstate eighty-seven in the town of Lake George, county of Warren, to Officer Stephen L. Raymond.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Warren to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to Bradley Murphy, a patrol officer employed by such county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Warren to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to Bradley Murphy, a patrol officer employed by such county.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain property in the village of Lake Placid from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain property in the village of Lake Placid, town of North Elba, from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church.

sponsored.t: Relates to the amount of St. Lawrence county economic development power that may be used by the New York Power Authority to generate net earnings
sponsored.sum: Relates to the amount of St. Lawrence county economic development power that may be used by the New York Power Authority to generate net earnings and authority-TMED contracts.

sponsored.t: Exempts veterans and those on active duty from paying certain fees for travel
sponsored.sum: Exempts veterans and those on active duty from paying certain fees for travel on the New York world war veterans memorial highway in Essex county or Prospect mountain veteran's memorial highway in Warren county.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Clinton to employ retired former members of the division of state police as special patrol officers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Clinton to employ retired former members of the division of state police as special patrol officers.

sponsored.t: Authorizes an expedited application review process for certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with Double H Ranch
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an expedited application review process for certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with Double H Ranch; provides such application fee shall be waived.

sponsored.t: Relates to transferring the village of Potsdam housing authority to the village of Canton housing authority; repealer
sponsored.sum: Transfers the village of Potsdam housing authority to the village of Canton housing authority; repeals provisions relating to the village of Potsdam housing authority.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of timeout boxes, closets or other secluded physical enclosures in schools in the state
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of timeout boxes, closets or other secluded physical enclosures for children in schools in the state.

sponsored.t: Limits the use of timeout boxes, closets or other secluded physical enclosures in schools in the state
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of timeout boxes, closets or other secluded physical enclosures for children in schools in the state except for authorized uses prescribed by the commissioner.

sponsored.t: Includes Hague Brook in the list of inland waterways eligible for the local waterfront revitalization program
sponsored.sum: Includes Hague Brook in the list of inland waterways eligible for the local waterfront revitalization program.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the state to convey certain forest preserve land
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the state to convey certain forest preserve land; provides such sale shall be subject to legislative approval and the proceeds of such conveyance shall be used for acquisitions to the forest preserve.
sponsored.fis: Any revenue derived from the conveyance of these lands will be paid into an account of the state to be used only for acquisitions to the Forest Preserve.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing health care professionals to perform services at the Ironman Lake Placid
sponsored.sum: Allows out of state health care professionals to perform services at the Ironman Lake Placid 2026.

sponsored.t: Adds Falls Brook, Jones Brook, Kelso Brook, Minerva Stream, and Trout Brook to the definition of inland waterways for the purposes of waterfront revitalization
sponsored.sum: Adds Falls Brook, Jones Brook, Kelso Brook, Minerva Stream, and Trout Brook to the definition of inland waterways for the purposes of waterfront revitalization.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance coverage for pediatric acute-onset neuropsychiatric syndrome
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance policies to cover costs for pediatric acute-onset neuropsychiatric syndrome rehabilitation treatment.

sponsored.t: Transfers certain state property located in the town of Queensbury to the county of Warren
sponsored.sum: Transfers certain state property owned by the New York state division of military and naval affairs located in the town of Queensbury to the county of Warren provided certain requirements are met.

sponsored.t: Establishes a commission on hosting the olympic games
sponsored.sum: Establishes a commission on Lake Placid and a partner municipality hosting the olympic games.

sponsored.t: Relates to Medicaid accountability
sponsored.sum: Relates to improving Medicaid accountability; verifies Medicaid enrollment data; audits certain Medicaid program areas; creates managed care payment safeguards; establishes a biometric verification pilot program.
sponsored.fis: Administrative and systems costs associated with implementation are expected to be offset, in part, by recoveries and avoided improper payments.

sponsored.t: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the town of Plattsburgh
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the town of Plattsburgh, not to exceed five percent of the per diem rental rate for each room.

sponsored.t: Enacts the regional equity in policy implementation act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the regional equity in policy implementation act; establishes a regional impact assessment framework; requires a ten-point regional impact test for statewide climate, energy, and infrastructure policies.

sponsored.t: Grants a waiver to Adirondack Helping Hands for the 2016--2017 school year
sponsored.sum: Grants a waiver in the amount of $52,000 to Adirondack Helping Hands for services rendered during the 2016--2017 school year; provides such waiver shall be allocated to costs associated with special class in an integrated setting spending for the 2016--2017 school year.
sponsored.fis: It could result in additional funding for Adirondack Helping Hands Inc.

sponsored.t: Permits sales during the Adirondack Family Book Festival at the John Brown Farm State Historic Site in North Elba, Essex County
sponsored.sum: Permits sales during the Adirondack Family Book Festival at the John Brown Farm State Historic Site in North Elba, Essex County.

sponsored.t: Establishes a forestry stewardship and habitat conservation credit for personal income and business franchise taxes
sponsored.sum: Establishes a forestry stewardship and habitat conservation credit for personal income and business franchise taxes.
sponsored.fis: When fully implemented, this act would reduce State revenue by $3 million annually.

sponsored.t: Provides that the town board of certain towns may establish maximum speed limits on certain town highways
sponsored.sum: Provides that the town board of any town, exclusive of suburban towns and towns having a population exceeding fifty thousand, may by local law, ordinance, order, rule or regulation establish maximum speed limits on town highways which have been classified by the department of transportation as local roads and which are outside of villages.

sponsored.t: Prohibits a skier from skiing in any area unless such skier is wearing a protective helmet; applicable to skiers under fourteen years of age
sponsored.sum: Relates to the duties of skiers and ski area operators regarding the use of helmets; requires skiers under age 14 to wear helmets; requires ski area operators to maintain an adequate supply of helmets for sale and rental; requires operators to post signs.

sponsored.t: Relates to the classification of historical lands and buildings located within the forest preserve
sponsored.sum: Relates to the classification of historical lands and buildings located within the forest preserve.

sponsored.t: Authorizes one or more demonstration projects that permit a managed long-term care plan to enroll persons that are permanently placed in a nursing home in rural areas
sponsored.sum: Authorizes one or more demonstration projects that permit a managed long-term care plan to enroll persons that are permanently placed in a nursing home and to manage the nursing home benefit in one or more rural areas.

sponsored.t: Provides for the establishment of a separate office of family court judge for the county of Essex
sponsored.sum: Provides for the establishment of a separate office of family court judge for the county of Essex.
sponsored.fis: The compensation payable for this separate office of judge of the family court shall be the same as the compensation payable to the judge of the county court of the county of Essex.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Massena to issue bonds to cover the cost of pension contributions due by the town for employees of the former Massena Memorial Hospital
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Massena to issue bonds to cover the cost of pension contributions due by the town for employees of the former Massena Memorial Hospital.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Canton to reduce the speed limit on certain public roadways
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Canton to reduce the speed limit on East Main Street to forty miles per hour.
sponsored.fis: None to the state. This legislation may have a positive fiscal impact on the locality by reducing the number of traffic incidents on its roads.

sponsored.t: Relates to the issue of non-commercial drivers' licenses and learners' permits in counties which contain in whole or in part boundary land; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the issue of non-commercial drivers' licenses and learners' permits in counties which contain in whole or in part boundary land.

sponsored.t: Repeals sections of law relating to private roads
sponsored.sum: Relates to private roads; repeals various provisions relating to the application for the creation of a private road.
sponsored.fis: No cost to state or local governments; potential cost savings to munici- palities by eliminating the potential for an individual requesting an outmoded quasi-judicial procedure as opposed to submitting applications to the local zoning authority.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities to contract for services through contracts let by any other governmental entity
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities to contract for services through contracts let by any other governmental entity.
sponsored.fis: This legislation would provide savings to municipalities through expand- ing access to cooperative purchasing of services.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance and Medicaid coverage for inpatient and outpatient substance abuse treatment for a period of not less than forty-five days
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance and Medicaid coverage for inpatient and outpatient substance abuse treatment for a period of not less than forty-five days.

sponsored.t: Excludes the value of state forest preserve lands in the Adirondack and Catskill parks from use in the determination of state aid to school districts
sponsored.sum: Excludes the value of state forest preserve lands in the Adirondack and Catskill parks from use in the determination of state aid to school districts.

sponsored.t: Directs a full cost benefit analysis of the technical and economic feasibility of renewable energy systems in the state of New York and to compare such directly with other methods of electricity generation
sponsored.sum: Directs the public service commission in consultation with NYSERDA to conduct a full cost benefit analysis of the technical and economic feasibility of renewable energy systems in the state of New York and to compare such directly with other methods of electricity generation within nine months after the effective date and every four years thereafter.
sponsored.fis: Minimal administrative costs to the State pursuant to contracting for a third party consultant to undertake the study.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain electronic court appearances
sponsored.sum: Authorizes electronic court appearances for criminal matters, excluding jury trials, in all counties in the state; authorizes electronic appearances for criminal matters where the court determines a personal appearance would be impractical, unsafe or excessively burdensome; authorizes sentencing to a period of incarceration to be conducted via electronic appearance for defendants who are already incarcerated.
sponsored.fis: This bill will result significant savings for counties.

sponsored.t: Relates to the computation of building aid for the Boquet Valley Central School District
sponsored.sum: Relates to the computation of building aid for the construction, reconstruction or modernizing of no more than one project by the Boquet Valley Central school district.

sponsored.t: Relates to safe staffing levels at nursing homes
sponsored.sum: Relates to safe staffing levels at nursing homes; requires the department of health to give significant weight to labor supply shortages in particular regions during any declared statewide disaster emergency.

sponsored.t: Requires the state pay taxes on the assessed value of properties of closed state prisons
sponsored.sum: Requires the state pay taxes on the assessed value of properties of closed state prisons until such prison is reopened, used by another state agency, or is conveyed to a non-governmental entity.
sponsored.fis: None to Local Government, TBD for the State

sponsored.t: Creates a tax credit for small businesses that sell a certain percentage of products produced in New York state
sponsored.sum: Creates a tax credit for small businesses that sell a certain percentage of products produced in New York state; provides such small businesses include independently or privately-owned cafes, restaurants, eateries, bars, pubs, breweries, distilleries, orchards, food trucks, retail stores, farm stands, hotels, or motels.

sponsored.t: Relates to segregated confinement; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to segregated confinement; provides that certain incarcerated individuals shall not be placed in a residential rehabilitation unit; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to special districts for ambulance services and to volunteer firefighter and ambulance services staffing
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of special districts for general ambulance services; requires a report on issues of volunteer firefighter and ambulance services staffing.

sponsored.t: Relates to special districts for ambulance services
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of special districts for general ambulance services in any county, city, town or village located within the Adirondack park.

sponsored.t: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the Samuel Trombley Memorial Bridge
sponsored.sum: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Ellenburg, county of Clinton as the "Samuel Trombley Memorial Bridge".

sponsored.t: Requiring the county seat in Warren county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting
sponsored.sum: Requires the county seat in Warren county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting.

sponsored.t: Directs the public service commission to conduct a full cost benefit analysis on renewable energy systems; and makes changes in relation to greenhouse gas emission limits
sponsored.sum: Directs the public service commission to conduct a full cost benefit analysis of the technical and economic feasibility of renewable energy systems in the state of New York and to compare such directly with other methods of electricity generation; makes certain changes relating to greenhouse gas emissions limits.

sponsored.t: Relates to repealing the driver's license access and privacy act
sponsored.sum: Repeals the driver's license access and privacy act.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of body scanners in correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of body scanners in correctional facilities by both visitors and incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Establishes the definition for legislation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the definition for legislation; provides that such proposed language shall be presented in a clear and concise manner, be limited to 50 pages and use words that have common everyday meanings.

sponsored.t: Requires the state to pay real property taxes on the assessed value of the Moriah shock incarceration correctional facility
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to pay all real property taxes on the assessed value of the Moriah shock incarceration correctional facility.
sponsored.fis: To be determined for State, none to Local

sponsored.t: Relates to the taxation of property owned by a cooperative corporation
sponsored.sum: Relates to the taxation of property owned by a cooperative corporation in the towns of Bolton, Horicon, Thurman, Queensbury, Lake George, and Warrensburg.

sponsored.t: Relates to the calculation of selected operating aid per pupil for the Boquet Valley central school district
sponsored.sum: Relates to the calculation of selected operating aid per pupil for the Boquet Valley central school district; provides the date of reorganization, July 1, 2019, shall be used when calculating.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the legislative commission on the development of rural resources to study the effectiveness of pond and lake management programs
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the legislative commission on the development of rural resources to study the effectiveness of pond and lake management programs; provides for the comprehensive control and mitigation of harmful algal blooms in both marine and fresh water; provides for emergency response to water contaminations by algal bloom or hypoxia.
sponsored.fis: The initial programmatic costs will be similar to setup of the State's invasive species program, and other funding will be available subject to appropriation when and if such appropriations are made therefor.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Jamie Rose care provider act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Jamie Rose care provider act"; requires health care facilities have policies for suspected victims of domestic abuse.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of SUNY dormitories for the purposes of providing permanent or temporary housing for migrant populations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of SUNY dormitories for the purposes of providing permanent or temporary housing for migrant populations; requests the board of trustees adopt a policy stating such.

sponsored.t: Relates to grants for graduate medical education in Lyme and tick-borne disease
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of health to award grants for graduate medical education in Lyme and tick-borne disease and to designate organizations as centers for Lyme and tick-borne disease excellence.

sponsored.t: Creates a tax credit for instructors of a hunting safety course
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating a tax credit for instructors of a hunting safety course of up to $300.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for taxpayers who donate equipment or materials to first responder live training programs
sponsored.sum: Establishes the first responder live training tax credit.

sponsored.t: Relates to tick-borne disease testing in children
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pilot program for Lyme and tick-borne disease testing in children.

sponsored.t: Establishes a third-party vendor program to send certain packages to incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Establishes a third-party vendor program of not more than 10 vendors to send certain packages to incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "wireless broadband eligible facility permitting act" to provide for uniform regulation of certain wireless facilities
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "wireless broadband eligible facility permitting act" to provide for uniform regulation of certain wireless facilities.
sponsored.fis: No cost to the state. The legislation should result in some cost savings for local governments.

sponsored.t: Grants Barbara Juh Tier 5 status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive Tier 5 status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Barbara Juh.

sponsored.t: Provides for a grace period in which former employees of the department of corrections and community supervision that participated in a strike may return to work
sponsored.sum: Provides for a grace period until July 1, 2025, in which former employees of the department of corrections and community supervision that participated in a strike may return to full duty without discipline.

sponsored.t: Establishes a distinctive plate for the Adirondack park
sponsored.sum: Establishes a distinctive plate for the Adirondack park.

sponsored.t: Relates to the provision of on-premises alcohol consumption licenses
sponsored.sum: Relates to the provision of on-premises alcohol consumption licenses; provides such licenses may be provided if the owner or administrator of a school, church, or other place of worship affirmatively provides support for the issuance of such license and such license would have been denied only for the proximity to such buildings.

sponsored.t: Establishes a digital legal mail program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a digital legal mail program for the delivery of privileged correspondences to incarcerated individuals housed at correctional facilities; requires law offices sending legal mail via digital platforms to incarcerated individuals to register with the department of corrections.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "in-route safety inspection for motor coach vehicles act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "in-route safety inspection for motor coach vehicles act"; establishes a framework for mandatory in-route inspections for motor coach vehicles carrying 16 or more passengers to reduce the risk of accidents and enhance operational oversight.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "motor carrier safety compliance requirement act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "motor carrier safety compliance requirement act"; requires companies contracting with motor carriers to verify compliance with safety regulations, maintain proper oversight, and ensure adherence to established safety practices.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the "comprehensive passenger safety enhancement act"
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the "comprehensive passenger safety enhancement act" to enhance passenger safety in commercial passenger vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to the Mount Van Hoevenberg Olympic Sports Complex in Essex County
sponsored.sum: Relates to the Mount Van Hoevenberg Olympic Sports Complex in Essex County.
sponsored.fis: None, although the economy of the Lake Placid area and the State as a whole will benefit from the amendment.

sponsored.t: Relates to expenditures for Warren county community colleges; extends the effectiveness of provisions relating to an additional Warren county mortgage recording tax
sponsored.sum: Relates to Warren county no longer providing community colleges funding with excess funds from the collection of mortgage recording taxes as such money is allocated to the CDTA; extends the effectiveness of provisions relating to an additional Warren county mortgage recording tax to December 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Essex to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Essex to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization granted to the county of St. Lawrence to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization granted to the county of St. Lawrence to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2027.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance of a church
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain property located in the city of Glens Falls, county of Warren, from the prohibition of alcohol sales within two hundred feet of a building occupied as a church, synagogue or other place of worship.

sponsored.t: Waives the residency requirement for certain county attorney positions within Warren county
sponsored.sum: Waives the residency requirement for certain county attorney positions within Warren county including assistant district attorney, assistant public defender and assistant county attorney.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing residency requirements for Franklin county assistant district attorneys
sponsored.sum: Removes residency requirements for persons holding the office of assistant district attorney for the county of Franklin; provides that a person holding such office may reside in Franklin county or an adjoining county within the state.

sponsored.t: Raises the Clinton county hotel or motel tax from three percent to five percent
sponsored.sum: Raises the Clinton county hotel or motel tax from three percent to five percent.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing health care professionals to perform services at the Ironman Lake Placid
sponsored.sum: Allows out of state health care professionals to perform services at the Ironman Lake Placid 2025.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Franklin to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Franklin to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Clinton to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Clinton to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2027.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "wireless broadband eligible facility permitting act" to provide for uniform regulation of certain wireless facilities
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "wireless broadband eligible facility permitting act" to provide for uniform regulation of certain wireless facilities.
sponsored.fis: No cost to the state. The legislation should result in some cost savings for local governments.
